options.content:
**How to read this dashboard**

- **All AI figures on this dashboard are Claude Code OTel-only**, scoped to the Project and Claude Code OTel Teams filters above. Legacy Claude Admin-API and Cursor activity are excluded — neither carries a reliable per-project mapping. Every "per merged PR" ratio uses the same Project filter on the AI and PR sides; the AI side also uses the OTel Teams filter, while PR counts are not team-filtered. Interpret these as project-level delivery ratios rather than team-specific PR rates. PR Size (p85/median) stays scoped to the Project filter.
- AI spend and tokens come solely from `ai_model_usages`, which only Claude Code OTel writes to.
- MySQL has no built-in percentile function; p85 and the median are selected by row number from the full sorted distribution. For an even number of PRs, the median is the lower of the two middle observations rather than their average.
- **Developer filter:** AI figures match the developer's OTel email; PR counts and sizes match the PR author's GitHub account, using the account GitHub links to that email through the developer's commits. Developers marked *no GitHub link* have no PR figures, so the per-PR ratios show no data for them. An email that GitHub links to more than one account counts as *no GitHub link*. Account IDs are assumed to come from a single GitHub host (github.com).

panels.description: Total AI-generated lines added, Claude Code OTel-only, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) (`SUM(ai_activities.lines_added)`).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(lines_added) AS "AI Lines Generated"
FROM ai_activities
WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
  AND source_connection_id IN (
    SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer_emails) OR user_email IN ($developer_emails))

)

panels.description: Merged pull requests, scoped to the selected project(s).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "PRs Merged"
FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))

panels.description: AI-session lines added divided by merged PR count for the selected Project and time range. The AI numerator is filtered by Project and OTel Teams; the PR denominator is filtered by Project only. This is a project-level ratio, not a team-specific PR rate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(ai.n / NULLIF(prs.n, 0), 1) AS "AI Lines / PR"
FROM
  (SELECT SUM(lines_added) n FROM ai_activities
   WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
     AND source_connection_id IN (
       SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
       INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
       WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
     )
     AND $__timeFilter(date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer_emails) OR user_email IN ($developer_emails))) ai,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
   WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))) prs

panels.description: The 85th percentile of merged PR size (additions + deletions), scoped to the selected project(s). Computed exactly via row-numbering over the full size distribution, not approximated.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sizes AS (
  SELECT (pr.additions + pr.deletions) AS sz,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (pr.additions + pr.deletions)) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
  FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))
)
SELECT sz AS "PR Size p85" FROM sizes WHERE rn = CEIL(0.85 * total) LIMIT 1

panels.title: PR Size p85 (lines changed)

panels.description: Purple bars: Claude Code OTel tokens (input, output, cache read and cache creation), left axis. Neutral bars: merged PRs, right count axis. Different scales: compare each colour across weeks, not bar heights against each other. Completed weeks only; weeks begin Monday, and weeks with no data show as zero. Weeks before Claude Code OTel collection started show no AI bars and a per-PR ratio of 0: that means no data, not no usage. Hover for tokens per merged PR (left out when no PRs merged) and its change from the previous week. Token usage uses the Project and OTel Teams filters; merged PRs use Project only, so selecting a team narrows only the AI bars. Both sides follow the Developer filter.

matcher.options: Tokens per merged PR · WoW change

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE weekly_prs AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS n
  FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))
  GROUP BY 1
),
weekly_tok AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens) AS v
  FROM ai_model_usages
  WHERE source_connection_id IN (
    SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer_emails) OR user_email IN ($developer_emails))
  GROUP BY 1
),
wk AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < $__timeTo()
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week FROM wk
  WHERE TIMESTAMP(d) >= $__timeFrom() AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) <= DATE_ADD($__timeTo(), INTERVAL 1 SECOND)
),
r AS (
  SELECT w.week, COALESCE(a.v, 0) AS ai, COALESCE(p.n, 0) AS prs, COALESCE(a.v, 0) / NULLIF(p.n, 0) AS ratio
  FROM weeks w
  LEFT JOIN weekly_tok a ON a.week = w.week
  LEFT JOIN weekly_prs p ON p.week = w.week
)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.week, '%b %e') AS "Week",
  ROUND(ratio, 0) AS "Tokens per merged PR",
  ROUND(ai, 0) AS "Tokens",
  prs AS "PRs merged",
  ROUND(100 * (ratio / NULLIF(LAG(ratio) OVER (ORDER BY r.week), 0) - 1), 1) AS "Tokens per merged PR · WoW change"
FROM r
ORDER BY r.week

Each cell shows the ratio and its change from the previous week. Weeks begin Monday, and weeks with no data show as zero; read the indexed chart below only for relative trend shape.

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE weekly_prs AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS n

),
weekly_tok AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens) AS v
  FROM ai_model_usages
  WHERE source_connection_id IN (

    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))

  FROM ai_activities
  WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
    AND source_connection_id IN (

    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id

    ROUND(tok_per_pr, 0) AS tok_per_pr,
    ROUND(lines_per_pr, 1) AS lines_per_pr
  FROM filled
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT week, cost_per_pr, tok_per_pr, lines_per_pr,
    LAG(cost_per_pr) OVER (ORDER BY week) AS cost_per_pr_prev,
    LAG(tok_per_pr) OVER (ORDER BY week) AS tok_per_pr_prev,
    LAG(lines_per_pr) OVER (ORDER BY week) AS lines_per_pr_prev
  FROM rounded
)
SELECT week AS "Week",
  CONCAT(CONCAT('$', CASE WHEN ABS(cost_per_pr) >= 1000000000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(cost_per_pr / 1000000000, 1), 'B') WHEN ABS(cost_per_pr) >= 1000000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(cost_per_pr / 1000000, 1), 'M') WHEN ABS(cost_per_pr) >= 1000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(cost_per_pr / 1000, 1), 'K') ELSE FORMAT(cost_per_pr, 2) END),
    CASE
      WHEN cost_per_pr_prev IS NULL THEN ''
      WHEN cost_per_pr_prev = 0 AND cost_per_pr = 0 THEN '        ▬0.0%'
      WHEN cost_per_pr_prev = 0 THEN '        ▲ new'
      WHEN cost_per_pr > cost_per_pr_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▲', ROUND(100.0*(cost_per_pr-cost_per_pr_prev)/cost_per_pr_prev,1), '%')
      WHEN cost_per_pr < cost_per_pr_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▼', ROUND(100.0*(cost_per_pr_prev-cost_per_pr)/cost_per_pr_prev,1), '%')
      ELSE '        ▬0.0%'
    END
  ) AS "Cost / PR",
  CONCAT(CASE WHEN ABS(tok_per_pr) >= 1000000000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(tok_per_pr / 1000000000, 1), 'B') WHEN ABS(tok_per_pr) >= 1000000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(tok_per_pr / 1000000, 1), 'M') WHEN ABS(tok_per_pr) >= 1000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(tok_per_pr / 1000, 1), 'K') ELSE FORMAT(tok_per_pr, 0) END,
    CASE
      WHEN tok_per_pr_prev IS NULL THEN ''
      WHEN tok_per_pr_prev = 0 AND tok_per_pr = 0 THEN '        ▬0.0%'
      WHEN tok_per_pr_prev = 0 THEN '        ▲ new'
      WHEN tok_per_pr > tok_per_pr_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▲', ROUND(100.0*(tok_per_pr-tok_per_pr_prev)/tok_per_pr_prev,1), '%')
      WHEN tok_per_pr < tok_per_pr_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▼', ROUND(100.0*(tok_per_pr_prev-tok_per_pr)/tok_per_pr_prev,1), '%')
      ELSE '        ▬0.0%'
    END
  ) AS "Tokens / PR",
  CONCAT(CASE WHEN ABS(lines_per_pr) >= 1000000000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(lines_per_pr / 1000000000, 1), 'B') WHEN ABS(lines_per_pr) >= 1000000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(lines_per_pr / 1000000, 1), 'M') WHEN ABS(lines_per_pr) >= 1000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(lines_per_pr / 1000, 1), 'K') ELSE FORMAT(lines_per_pr, 1) END,
    CASE
      WHEN lines_per_pr_prev IS NULL THEN ''
      WHEN lines_per_pr_prev = 0 AND lines_per_pr = 0 THEN '        ▬0.0%'
      WHEN lines_per_pr_prev = 0 THEN '        ▲ new'
      WHEN lines_per_pr > lines_per_pr_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▲', ROUND(100.0*(lines_per_pr-lines_per_pr_prev)/lines_per_pr_prev,1), '%')
      WHEN lines_per_pr < lines_per_pr_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▼', ROUND(100.0*(lines_per_pr_prev-lines_per_pr)/lines_per_pr_prev,1), '%')
      ELSE '        ▬0.0%'
    END
  ) AS "AI Lines / PR"
FROM lagged
ORDER BY week DESC

panels.title: Cost / Tokens / AI Lines per PR — Weekly, with WoW % Change

panels.description: Monthly p85 and rank-selected median of merged PR size (additions + deletions) in the selected Project. The query selects observations by row number; with an even number of PRs, its median is the lower middle observation, not the average of the two middle values. A widening p85-to-median gap means the upper tail of PR sizes is growing relative to the typical PR.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sizes AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pr.merged_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month, (pr.additions + pr.deletions) AS sz
  FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT month, sz,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY sz) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY month) AS total
  FROM sizes
)
SELECT STR_TO_DATE(month, '%Y-%m-%d') AS time, 'p85' AS metric, sz AS value FROM ranked WHERE rn = CEIL(0.85 * total)
UNION ALL
SELECT STR_TO_DATE(month, '%Y-%m-%d'), 'median', sz FROM ranked WHERE rn = CEIL(0.5 * total)
ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: PR Size: p85 vs Median (lines changed, monthly)

WITH scoped_conn AS (
  SELECT cp.connection_id
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
  WHERE c.status = 'active'
    AND cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
),
otel AS (
  SELECT user_email AS email FROM ai_activities
  WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity' AND user_email <> '' AND source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM scoped_conn) AND $__timeFilter(date)
  UNION
  SELECT user_email FROM ai_model_usages
  WHERE user_email <> '' AND source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM scoped_conn) AND $__timeFilter(date)
),
linked AS (
  SELECT o.email, MIN(g.author_id) AS gid
  FROM otel o
  JOIN _tool_github_commits g ON g.author_email = o.email AND g.author_id > 0
  GROUP BY o.email
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.author_id) = 1
),
pr_authors AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1) AS UNSIGNED) AS gid, MAX(pr.author_name) AS login
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  WHERE pm.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE '%[bot]'
    AND ($__timeFilter(pr.created_date) OR $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) OR $__timeFilter(pr.closed_date))
  GROUP BY 1
),
people AS (
  SELECT CONCAT('gh:', l.gid) AS k, l.gid, MIN(l.email) AS email, NULL AS login, 1 AS has_ai FROM linked l GROUP BY l.gid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CONCAT('em:', o.email), NULL, o.email, NULL, 1 FROM otel o WHERE o.email NOT IN (SELECT email FROM linked)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CONCAT('gh:', p.gid), p.gid, NULL, p.login, 0 FROM pr_authors p WHERE p.gid NOT IN (SELECT gid FROM linked)
),
named AS (
  SELECT p.k, p.has_ai, COALESCE(ga.login, p.login, p.email) AS handle,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(ga.name, ''), ga.login, p.login, p.email) AS name
  FROM people p
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(login) AS login, MAX(name) AS name FROM _tool_github_accounts GROUP BY id) ga ON ga.id = p.gid
)
SELECT CONCAT(
    name,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY name) > 1 AND handle <> name THEN CONCAT(' (', handle, ')') ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN k LIKE 'em:%' THEN ' · no GitHub link' WHEN has_ai = 0 THEN ' · no AI data' ELSE '' END
  ) AS __text,
  k AS __value
FROM named
ORDER BY has_ai DESC, __text;
